attempts.summary: Configured node1, node2, node3 as a 3-member MariaDB Galera cluster (mariadb-server + galera-4 on Ubuntu 24.04, wsrep_sst_method=rsync). Verified writes from any member replicate to the others, that the cluster stays available with quorum when one member is down and auto-resyncs via IST when it returns, and completed the mandatory sequential-reboot protocol on all three nodes with boot-id proof and post-reboot cluster/data recovery verification.
